Adama Science and Technology University Library provides access to quality academic resources, advanced digital platforms, and user-centered services that support the university community. Quick Access: • Search Books • Digital Library • Institutional Repository • E-Resources • Ask a Librarian About Us Library Overview ASTU Library is committed to delivering high-quality information resources and modern learning spaces for students, researchers, faculty members, and staff. The library combines traditional collections with innovative digital services to meet the changing academic needs of the university. Vision To become a leading academic library in science, engineering, and technology education through innovation and excellence. Mission To be the leading and preferable academic library in the country and the center of excellence in applied science and technology by 2030. Also, strive to foster intellectual growth, academic success, and lifelong learning for the students and staff of the university. ASTU as academic library, which serve the university community that, adds a value in the teaching learning process by providing the relevant information resources for students and university community. Motto • The sun never sets on ASTU Library! Opening Hours • Monday-Saturday (8:00AM - 6:00 PM) Sunday (8:00 AM - 10:00PM) and Closed in public holidays. E-Resources Access world-class academic databases and electronic journal and ebooks: • IEEE • Wiley https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/ • Taylor & Francis http://www.tandfonline.com/ and https://www.taylorfrancis.com/ • Emerald Publishing https://www.emerald.com/insight/ • Springer https://www.springernature.com/gp • Hein Online https://heinonline.org/HOL/Welcome These resources support teaching, assignments, research, and innovation. Digital Library ASTU Digital Library provides online access to science, engineering, and technology learning materials including books, lecture notes, journals, and institutional publications. Website : www.dl.astu.edu.et Institutional Repository (ASTU-ETD) The ASTU Institutional Repository, also known as ASTU-ETD, preserves and provides access to postgraduate theses, dissertations, and scholarly outputs produced by the university community. Website : http://www.etd.edu.et Services We provide the following services: • Online Catalog Search • Books Search • Journals Search • Theses & Dissertations Access • Digital Collections • New Arrivals Updates • Reserved Materials • Reference Support • Reading Spaces • Internet & Wi-Fi Access Membership Library membership is available for: • Students • Academic Staff • Administrative Staff • External Users (approved conditions apply) Research Intelligent Systems Enhance your research productivity using: • Scopus https://www.scopus.com • SciVal https://www.scival.com These platforms help researchers with citation analysis, benchmarking, collaboration discovery, and publication insights.
